claim_idea: Video shows religious procession in Odisha linked to CJP protests in Pakistan

title: Old image falsely claims Altaf Hussain hospitalised
text:
Claim: An image shows former MQM leader Altaf Hussain hospitalised and in critical condition

Fact: This claim is false There are no credible news reports stating that Altaf Hussain is hospitalised currently, and the image is from July 2025.

On 13 July 2026, X user ‘Saleem Speak’ posted an image of MQM founder Altaf Hussain hospitalised, claiming that the former leader was “breathing his last”. The image was accompanied by the following Urdu caption:

“کراچی میں صرف الطاف بھائی کہو تو پورا شہر پانچ منٹ میں بند ہو جاتا تھا لندن سے ٹی وی پر خطاب کرتا تھا تو لوگ کانپتے ہوئے اس کے ٹی وی والے خطاب کے سامنے ایسے بیٹھتے تھے جیسے قرآن سننے آئے ہوں ۔ بڑے بڑے سنئیر تجزیہ نگار ہوتے انکی مجال نہی تھی پاکستان میں الطاف حسین کے نام کوی منفی خبر دیں اے ار وای لاہور سٹوڈیو میں الطاف حسین کے بارے میں بات ہو رہی تھی ۔ پانچ منٹ بعد کراچی میں اے ار وی کا دفتر میں سب یرغمال بنے ہوے تھے پروگرام روکنا پڑ گیا تھا ۔ قربانی کی کھالوں پر صرف بھاؤ کے نام کا اسٹامپ لگا کر جاؤ تو پورا کراچی چھان مارو وہ کھال تم سے کوئی نہیں لے گا ۔ صاحب کراچی کو اپنی مرضی سے چلانے کے لیے لندن سے صرف ایک حکم جاری کرتا تھا ا۔ آج اپنی اخری سانسیں لیتا یہ شخص اسپتال میں اپنوں کا انتظار کر رہا رابطہ کمیٹی نے بھی یہ تصویر جاری کر کے عوام سے دعا کی اپیل کی ہے اج کسی کو یاد ہی نہیں کہ کراچی میں کوئی الطاف حسین بھی تھا ۔ یہ ہے دنیا کی حقیقت کسی نے ہمیشہ نہی رہنا ہمیشہ رہنے والی ذات میرے رب کی ہے۔بڑے بڑے ظالم اے سب کا انجام عبرت ناک ہوتا ہے ۔ اج بھی وہ مائیں حیات ہیں جنکے بیٹے اس کی بھینٹ چڑھ گئے اج بھی بوری بند لاشیوں کے لواحقین سوال پوچھ رہے ہیں اخر قصور کیا تا انکا ۔ اج بھی اس ماں کی چیخیں میڈیا پر موجود ہیں جو یہ کہتی رہی مارنا تھا تو میرے لعل کو اتنا بے دردی سے نہ مارتے چہرہ تو سلامت رکھتے میں چوم سکتی اسے دیکھ سکتی اسے شاید میرا دل کو سکون مل جاتا مگر ظالمو ہمیں اخری دیدار بھی کربناک حالت میں کرایا گیا ۔ میرے بیٹے کی شناخت مجھے اس کے ہاتھ پر بچپن کے جلے ہوے نشان سے کرنی پڑی ۔”

[Translation: “In Karachi, if you just mention Altaf Bhai, the entire city would shut down in five minutes. He would address the TV from London, and people would sit trembling in front of his TV address as if they had come to listen to the Quran.

Even the big senior analysts were not allowed to give any negative news about Altaf Hussain in Pakistan. ARI Lahore studio was talking about Altaf Hussain.

Five minutes later, everyone in the ARY office in Karachi was taken hostage and the program had to be stopped.

Just stamp the name of Bhai on the sacrificial skins and go and search the whole Karachi, no one will take that skin from you.

Sahib used to issue only one order from London to run Karachi according to his will.

Today, this person is taking his last breaths in the hospital. The Coordination Committee has also released this picture and appealed to the people for prayers. Today, no one remembers that there was an Altaf Hussain in Karachi.

This is the reality of the world, no one lives forever, the eternal being of my Lord. The end of all great tyrants is instructive. Even today, those mothers are alive whose sons fell victim to them.

Even today, the relatives of the sacked bodies are asking questions.

What was their fault?

Even today, the screams of this mother are present in the media, who kept saying, “If you had to kill me, don’t kill my beloved so cruelly. I could have kissed her face, I could have seen her. Perhaps my heart would have found peace, but the tyrants made us meet in a miserable state.”

I had to identify my son by the burn mark on his hand from childhood.*]

Screenshot from X post

Soch Fact Check reverse-searched the image of the MQM leader in the hospital, which displayed reports from July 2025 .

Soch Fact Check further investigated this claim by looking at MQM’s official website ( archived here ) and seeing if there were any such updates for the month of July 2026. There has been no mention of the MQM leader being ill or being in a critical condition recently, and the last health update on him was published on 2 February 2026 ( archived here ). It states that the MQM leader  said he was administered an injection and an IV due to weakness, followed by another update ( archived here ) on 14 February 2026.

Moreover, Soch Fact Check reviewed the Convener of MQM’s Central Coordination Committee Mustafa Azizabadi’s X account. According to this account, the most recent update on Altaf Hussain’s health was from 20 February 2026 , saying that he “had been under treatment at a hospital in northwest London for the past 19 days” and had been discharged from the hospital at the time. The X post included a video of Hussain waving at the camera, while on a wheelchair. It did not include any picture of him on a hospital bed.

Then we found that prior to the February 2026 update, Azizabadi had posted a video along with the update that Altaf Hussain was in the hospital on 13 July 2025. The thumbnail of this video, as seen below, is quite similar to the image being fact-checked. This suggested that the claim is misleading as this picture was likely from July 2025.

A side-by-side comparison of Altaf Hussain in the hospital: the thumbnail of the video shared by Mustafa Azizabadi in July 2025 (Right) and the image in the claim (left).

Soch Fact Check then reached out to Murtaza Ali Shah , a London based journalist, for further verification. He responded saying:

“Yes, this image is authentic as Altaf Hussain was hospitalised at the time. I was the one to actually publish it in the first place. This image is more than 9 months old.” Upon investigation, it was found that the image was posted to the journalist’s X account on 12 July 2025. A screenshot of the X post shows an image of Altaf Hussain on the left-hand-side, which is identical to the one being fact-checked.

X post by Murtaza Ali Shah from 12 July 2025, showing Altaf Hussain in the hospital at the time.

Therefore, Soch Fact Check concludes that the claim is false, and the accompanying image showing Altaf Hussain hospitalised is old.

One Facebook reel making the claim gained 811 views whereas the Facebook posts with the most interaction gained 670 likes and 482 reshares.

On X, the claim received the highest interaction at 43.2K views.

Soch Fact Check has previously debunked false claims that Altaf Hussain had died when this particular image last circulated in July 2025.

Conclusion: The image showing Altaf Hussain hospitalised is old. Moreover, there are no credible news reports stating that he is currently hospitalised or in critical condition.

title: Images shared as victims in Raza Dar sexual assault case are AI-generated
text:
Claim: An image shows the victims of the recent kidnapping and sexual assault case reported in Lahore, which involved Muhammad Raza Dar, a relative of Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar.

Fact: This claim is false. As the image being circulated is AI-generated, and is not of the two foreign nationals from the Lahore case,

On 6 July 2024, Facebook user, Voice of Punjab posted an image with the following caption:

سی سی ڈی پنجاب کے “

اپنے نیفے میں رضا ڈار چل گیا

امیر کے لئے الگ قانون غریب کے لئے الگ ، پاکستان کی تاریخ گواہ ہے کہ جب بھی کوئی ادارہ سہی کام کرنے لگتا ہے اور عوام کا اعتماد اس ادارے پر ہونے لگتا ہے تو عین اسی وقت کسی سیاسی خاندان کے سپوت سے کرائم سرزد ہو جاتا ہے اور وہی ادارہ جو غریب غبارہ بیچنے والے ، سکنجبین والے ، کریانے کی دوکان پر کام کرنے والے ملازم کو فل فرائی یا ہاف فرائی کر دیتے تھے وہ سیاسی خاندان کے چشم و چراغ کو بچانے میں لگ جاتے ہیں اور پھر ادارے کی ساکھ خراب ہو جاتی ہے

امیر کے لئے علیحدہ قانون اور غریب کے لئے علیحدہ یہ پاکستان کی ریت ہے

تحریر : حارث کھوکھ

[Translation: “Raza Dar—a scion of a political family—has run amok. There is one law for the rich and another for the poor; Pakistan’s history bears witness that whenever an institution begins to function correctly and gains public trust, a crime is committed by a member of a political family at that very moment. The same institutions that would ruthlessly crack down on poor balloon sellers, lemonade vendors, or grocery store clerks suddenly busy themselves with shielding the scion of that political family, ultimately tarnishing the institution’s reputation.

Separate laws for the rich and the poor—such is the norm in Pakistan.

Written by: Haris Khokhar”]

Screenshot of the Facebook post being fact-checked

On 2 July, the Lahore police registered a case against five people suspected of kidnapping and sexually assaulting two foreign women. The FIR available with Soch Fact Check lists section 365A (kidnapping or abducting for extorting property, valuable security, etc) and 375A (gang rape). It mentioned a man named Muhammad Raza Dar, another person the women referred to as his “boss”, and three other men.

A copy of the FIR obtained by Soch Fact Check

The FIR stated that the two women named Stephanie and Astrid, a Dutch and a Venezuelan national respectively, first met Dar in Singapore in October 2025. According to Stephanie’s statement cited in a report by Dawn , he invited them to Pakistan and arranged their visas under the pretence of introducing them to new investors for her company. Soch Fact Check also obtained her original statement to the judicial magistrate in which she stated that she and Astrid arrived in Islamabad on 26 June and spent three days at a hotel.

An excerpt from Stephanie’s statement to the judicial magistrate on 2 July 2026

An excerpt from Stephanie’s statement to the judicial magistrate on 2 July 2026

In her statement, Stephanie added that they travelled to Lahore with Dar on 29 June 2026 where he lured them into a house under the pretext of celebrating a relative’s birthday. However, they found the residence empty. She added that within fifteen minutes, four armed men stormed inside and tied up both the women, after which they demanded high amounts of ransom. She stated that Dar initially pretended to be a victim too but later his complicity with the armed men had become evident.

According to the Dawn report, she accused the kidnappers of demanding $2 million and electronically transferring $17,000 in cryptocurrency from her accounts. She also detailed an account of sexual assault that took place on 30 June which was confirmed by medical reports issued on 6 July after the DNA of three of the suspects matched.

DIG Lahore Muhammad Faisal Kamran said in a press briefing that the FIR was registered after a man named Carlos, the father of one of the women, called the emergency helpline “15” from Spain and alerted the Defence assistant superintendent of police (ASP) about the situation.

Kamran added that the victims were rescued after the car transporting them to another location crashed into another vehicle which gave them the opportunity to escape and seek shelter in a shop near Bhatta Chowk. After being rescued, they departed from the country on 3 July, he added.

DIG Kamran also confirmed that when his team was trying to trace the suspects, they spoke to a few people living in the raided houses who informed them that the place was previously rented out by the relatives of Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar. A police official then identified one of the suspects as Muhammad Raza Dar after confirming the information from his family.

Dawn quoted police officials investigating the case claiming that a total of eight suspects have been arrested in the case, including someone the victims referred to as the “boss” who was providing instructions to the other men via a phone call, as described in the FIR.

On 3 July, the judicial magistrate at Cantt Courts in Lahore issued a remand order, a copy of which is available with Soch Fact Check , that approved a five-day physical remand for Ahmad Raza, Sikandar Aziz Khan, Hassan Raza and Sajid Ali. Later, on 13 July, the court extended their remand by four more days.

Remand order approved by the judicial magistrate in Cantt Court on 3 July

On 5 July 2026, the Prime Minister’s Adviser on Political Affairs Rana Sanaullah appeared on Geo News’ show ‘Naya Pakistan’ and stated that Deputy PM Ishaq Dar is being dragged in this matter “unnecessarily.”

“A non-issue is being turned into an issue. This matter is being stretched from left and right to create an effect for him [Ishaq Dar]. Even if his [Dar’s] relative is involved, no matter how close they are, he [Dar] is not responsible for his [Raza] words and actions,” Sanaullah stated .

Soch Fact Check obtained the official statements of the two victims from a crime reporter based in Lahore. The statements were given on 2 July 2026 to the Punjab Police. Soch Fact Check has redacted pictures of the victims to maintain their privacy. However, on comparison, the images from these official documents do not match the image circulating in the claim at all.

Page 1 of the sworn statement given by one of the victims, a Spanish national named Astrid Gabriela Robinson Bracho. The statement includes her authentic picture

As seen, Astrid’s face does not match the faces of either of the women in the image being fact-checked. The image of the second victim, Stephanie Adriana Mau Asam, provided in the copy of her sworn statement does not match the image in the claim either.

Seeing that neither of the victims’ original pictures from their recorded statements matched the image in the claim, Soch Fact Check conducted a reverse-image search to find the latter’s source and origins. The results do not link back to the original images, and since the image could not be traced back to an original source, we suspected it may be AI-generated.

Page 1 of the sworn statement given by one of the victims, a Dutch national named Stephanie Adriana Mau Asam. The statement includes her authentic picture

Results from AI-Detection Tools

First, we ran the image through Hive Moderation’s AI-Generated Content Detection tool, used specifically for the photo with the two women that was cropped from the post when running it through these tools. The tool analyses visual patterns, textures, lighting, and facial features amongst other characteristics and provides a probable source for the image and videos while checking if it’s AI.

According to the tool’s results, the image is 82.3% likely to be AI-generated, and 97.9% likely to be a deepfake. In the breakdown of generation sources, Q wen , which generates AI images based on the prompts given by the creator, was identified as one of the top sources.

Results given by Hive Moderation for the image

According to Google DeepMind , SynthID embeds digital watermarks directly into AI-generated images, audio, text, and video. The watermarks are embedded across Google’s generative AI consumer products, and are imperceptible to humans but can be detected by SynthID’s technology. Soch Fact Check then ran the image through OpenAI’s tool designed to check if it was created using the American company’s artificial intelligence tools. The results confirmed that a SynthID watermark originating from OpenAI was found in the image, proving that an existing picture has been manipulated or has been modified using AI.

OpenAI identified the presence of a SynthID watermark in the image

Based on official records and results from AI detection tools, we conclude that the image in the claim does not show the two victims of sexual assault and kidnapping case involving Raza Dar. It is, in fact, AI-generated.

This viral image was shared on Facebook and saw interaction in thousands, ranging from 4.2K to 1.3k likes.

On Instagram one reel gained 229 likes and 17 comments.

Posts on X also received thousands of views, with the most popular ones receiving 28.8K views,  18.5K views, 6.1K views, and 1.9K views, respectively.

Conclusion: The image in the claim does not two women who were victims in the sexual assault and kidnapping case involving Raza Dar. It is, in fact, AI-generated.

To appeal against our fact-check, please send an email to appeals@sochfactcheck.com

We are a team of non-partisan fact checkers investigating disinformation and committed to responsible journalism. Pakistan’s only IFCN signatory.

title: Image of Deputy PM Ishaq Dar’s son falsely linked to Raza Dar?
text:
Claim : An image shows Raza Dar posing next to former Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif and Deputy Prime Minister of Pakistan Ishaq Dar.

Fact : The claim is false. The person standing next to Nawaz Sharif in the image is not Raza Dar, but Deputy PM Ishaq Dar’s son, Hasnain Dar.

On 4 July 2026, X user Arsalan Baloch posted an image, with the Urdu caption:

ملزم رضا ڈار نے اپنی تصویر ایک سابق وزیراعظم کے ساتھ لگا رکھی تھی:))

[Translation: “Raza Dar had posted a picture of himself with a former Prime Minister:))”]

Screenshot from X post

On 2 July, the Lahore police registered a case against five people suspected of kidnapping and sexually assaulting two foreign women. A police official then identified one of the suspects as Muhammad Raza Dar after confirming the information from his family.

Dawn quoted police officials investigating the case claiming that a total of eight suspects have been arrested in the case, including someone the victims referred to as the “boss” who was providing instructions to the other men via a phone call, as described in the FIR.

Later, on 13 July, the court extended their remand by four more days.

Remand order approved by the judicial magistrate in Cantt Court on 3 July

On 5 July 2026, the Prime Minister’s Adviser on Political Affairs Rana Sanaullah appeared on Geo News’ show ‘Naya Pakistan’ and stated that Deputy PM Ishaq Dar is being dragged in this matter “unnecessarily.”

“A non-issue is being turned into an issue. This matter is being stretched from left and right to create an effect for him [Ishaq Dar]. Even if his [Dar’s] relative is involved, no matter how close they are, he [Dar] is not responsible for his [Raza] words and actions,” Sanaullah stated .

Soch Fact Check ran a reverse-image search on this image to find its origins and the true identity of the man on the left of the frame. The picture was first posted by Ali Dar , Chief Minister of Punjab for Artificial Intelligence and Special Initiatives on X on 3 March 2024 , tagging all 3 people present in the picture.

The image was found to be posted by The search results confirmed that the man in question is Hasnain Dar, son of Pakistan’s Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar. This was established through a review of Hasnain Dar’s X account , where the images posted mention Ishaq Dar as his father.

Soch Fact Check also found a Geo News video showing Nawaz Sharif meeting several of Ishaq Dar’s family members. Towards the 1:34 mark, Hasnain Dar can be seen in a group photo. This video dates back to 19 October 2023, and is captioned “Nawaz Sharif reached the house of Ali Dar and Hasnain Dar, sons of Ishaq Dar, in Dubai.” It is clear that the image being fact-checked also shows Hasnain Dar.

Side-by-side comparison of Hasnain Dar in the image being fact-checked (left) and in the Geo News clip (on the right hand side)

Intelligence Online, a French publication published an article on 6 April 2023, which states Hasnain Dar and Ali Mustafa Dar to be Ishaq Dar sons and includes similar pictures circulating on social media. The picture seen in the article was also posted by Ali Dar, seen on his X account on 27 September 2022.

Image obtained from Intelligence Online

Soch Fact Check, therefore, concludes the image in the claim does not show Muhammad Raza Dar. In fact, based on publicly available information, the person in question can be identified as Hasnain Dar, who is the son of Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar.

This image was shared the most on Facebook, with the highest number of likes at 2.1K.

Pakistani users shared the misinformation on X as well where the most popular post gained 128.7K views.

Conclusion: The claim is false. The person standing next to Nawaz Sharif in the image in question is not Raza Dar but Deputy PM Ishaq Dar’s son, Hasnain Dar.

title: No recent loadshedding announcement, old news reshared
text:
Claim: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA) announced loadshedding will take place every evening for 2 hours and 30 minutes from 5pm to 1am, Aaj News reported.

Fact: This claim is misleading. The Aaj News bulletin in the post dates back to April 2026. Moreover, NEPRA has not announced any such loadshedding schedule recently, as of 20 July 2026.

On 1 July 2026, X user Syeda Sherazi posted a news bulletin, seemingly by Aaj News , announcing The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority’s (NEPRA) new loadshedding schedule. The caption accompanying the post in Urdu stated:

بریکنگ  مردہ پاکستانی قوم کو مبارک ہو، بجلی مہنگی بھی ہے اور دیں گے بھی اپنی مرضی سے، لوڈ شیڈنگ بڑھتی جارہی ہے مگر نااہل عوام خاموش سے سہہ رہی ہے ظالمو متحد ہو جاؤ

[Translation: “Breaking Congratulations to the dead Pakistani nation, electricity is expensive and they’ll give it however they please, load shedding keeps increasing but the incompetent people are silently enduring it O tyrants, unite.” ]

Screenshot from X post

The image declares load shedding that will take place for 2 hours and 30 minutes, between the hours of 5pm and 1am.

Soch Fact Check first reverse-searched this image to find if Aaj News had reported this news recently. The results revealed that the news bulletin seen in the X post is authentic, and had been officially announced by Aaj News , and was uploaded on the news channel’s official YouTube and Instagram pages, dated 14th April 2026.

Below we see the visuals taken from Aaj News’ Instagram post, and the visuals present are identical to the ones from the X post. This shows both these visuals were taken from Aaj News , and reposted in July but in a different format causing it to be misleading.

Identical visuals seen from Aaj News socials (left ) as seen from X post (right)

A deeper search led to news articles reporting on the 2 hour and 30 minute peak hour loadshedding announcement from 14 and 15 April 2026 . The articles state the Government of Pakistan’s Power Division announced this news due to rising electricity demand during peak hours. The Power Division had stated that they faced the biggest challenge during peak hours of 5pm and 1am, but due to the closure of the Strait of Hormuz at that time, energy needed to be conserved, hence load shedding was implemented by the government. K-Electric and HESCO were exempted from this load shedding plan.

Soch Fact Check looked into the official website and X accounts of the Ministry of Energy- Power Division, Government of Pakistan’s  for any updates as of 20 July 2026. The only update on such a ruling was found on their X account in Urdu on 14 April 2026 as seen below :

Official update found on Ministry’s  X account

The Ministry of Energy posted an English version of this announcement on the same date on their official website stating:

“ THE POWER DIVISION SPOKESPERSON HAS ISSUED AN IMPORTANT STATEMENT REGARDING THE PEAK HOURS RELIEF STRATEGY, HIGHLIGHTING KEY DEVELOPMENTS IN ELECTRICITY PRICING AND DEMAND MANAGEMENT.

The Power Division spokesperson has issued an important statement regarding the Peak Hours Relief Strategy, highlighting key developments in electricity pricing and demand management.

According to the statement, consistent efforts by the Power Division have led to a reduction in electricity prices for consumers across the country. From July to February, the average tariff has decreased by 71 paisa per unit despite rising fuel costs. This has resulted in a total relief of Rs 46 billion.

The reduction has been achieved through structural reforms, targeted relief measures, strict implementation of the merit order, improved planning and more efficient system operations. Priority has been given to low-cost generation sources, while better use of generation capacity and improvements in transmission and administration have helped reduce losses. These combined efforts have improved overall system performance and provided sustainable relief to consumers.

The spokesperson said that despite challenging global conditions, the country’s power generation remains stable. The system is capable of meeting electricity demand as required.

However, the main challenge at present is during peak hours from 5:00 pm to 1:00 am. During this time, demand increases significantly, mainly due to reduced hydel generation. Relying on expensive fuels to meet this demand could lead to a substantial increase in electricity prices.

Keeping this in view, the government has decided to suspend electricity supply for about 2.25 hours daily between 5:00 pm and 1:00 am. This step is aimed at reducing the use of costly fuels and preventing a sharp rise in tariffs.

The situation is being closely monitored under the direct supervision of the Prime Minister. The government has directed that electricity prices must not increase sharply. Even if the use of furnace oil leads to some increase, all possible steps are being taken to keep it to a minimum.

In line with these directions, 80 MMCFD of local gas has been provided to power plants. This has helped avoid an increase of about 80 paisa per unit and has also reduced the need for additional load management.

He said that the limited load management of 2.25 hours during peak times is intended to prevent an increase of around Rs 3 per unit. Even with restricted use of furnace oil, there may still be an increase of about Rs 1.5 per unit. Without these measures, the increase could have reached Rs 5 to Rs 6 per unit.

Distribution companies have been directed to share feeder-wise outage schedules with consumers at all levels. This will ensure that consumers are aware of outage timings. No unscheduled outages will be allowed. In case of local faults, the concerned offices will inform consumers accordingly.

The government is making every effort to minimize the impact of international conditions on the public. All possible measures are being taken to provide relief to consumers.

The spokesperson clarified that this step is not load shedding. It is part of the government’s “Peak Relief Strategy” aimed at controlling possible increases in electricity prices during peak hours.

The government remains committed to providing maximum relief to the public despite global challenges. It will continue to take all necessary steps to keep electricity prices under control. Coordinated efforts by federal and provincial governments, including timely closure of commercial markets, can further reduce demand and help limit any potential increase in electricity costs.”

For further verification NEPRA’s website does not show any new announcement as of 20 July 2026, on Pakistan’s Peak Hours Relief Strategy.

Based on the official record found on the Ministry of Energy’s website and authentic news reports, Soch Fact Check concludes the claim is misleading and this news dates back to April 2026.

The claim received about 1030 to 846 views on X.

The Facebook post saw 23 likes and 7 reshares.

On Instagram, the claim garnered 1.2K likes and 153 comments.

Conclusion: The news bulletin from Aaj News dates back to April 2026

We are a team of non-partisan fact checkers investigating disinformation and committed to responsible journalism. Pakistan’s only IFCN signatory.

title: Images of Pakistan Army soldiers looting shops in Rawalakot are not authentic
text:
Claim: Two images show soldiers from the Pakistan Army trying to break into the local shops in Rawalakot and loot valuables amid the recent unrest in Azad Jammu and Kashmir.

Fact: These images are manipulated by AI.

On 13 June 2026, Facebook user Ghulam Mustafa posted images that show Pakistani soldiers allegedly looting local shops. The images were posted with the following caption:

“راولا کوٹ میں کرفیو لگا کر یزیدی فورسز نے دوکانیں لوٹ لی ہیں

فورسز کی طرف سے تاجران کی دکانوں کے تالے توڑ کر اشیائے خوردونوش، زیورات و نقدی رقوم کی لوٹ مار کرنا انتہائی شرمناک ہے- حکمرانوں کے ساتھ ہماری جنگ صرف اس بنیاد پر ہے کہ وہ ہمارے وسائل کھا جاتے ہیں اور اپنی لوٹ مار کے تحفظ کیلئے فورسز کا استعمال کرتے ہیں- اور اب ان فورسز کی طرف سے لوگوں کی ذاتی املاک کو نقصان پہنچانا ، گھروں میں گھُس کر چادر اور چار دیواری کا تقدس پامال کیا جا رہا ہے-

حکمرانوں کو متنبی کرتے ہیں کہ ایسے اقدامات سے گریز کریں اور پُرامن عوام کے تسلیم شدہ مطالبات پر فی الفور عملدرآمد کیا جائے۔

[Translation : Yazidi forces have looted shops after imposing curfew in Rawalakot. It is extremely shameful for the forces to break the locks of traders’ shops and loot food items, jewelry and cash. Our war with the rulers is only on the basis that they consume our resources and use the forces to protect their loot. And now these forces are damaging people’s personal property, entering homes and violating the sanctity of the chador and four walls. We warn the rulers to avoid such measures and immediately implement the recognized demands of the peaceful people.]

Screenshot from Facebook post

This article only fact-checks the authenticity of the images; we have not independently investigated claims of looting made in the caption

Clashes in Pakistan-administered Kashmir

On 7 June 2026, severe, deadly clashes erupted between law enforcement personnel and protesters in Rawalakot in Pakistan-administered Kashmir when crowds gathered outside the Combined Military Hospital (CMH).

The clashes occurred after police arrived at the location to disperse a sit-in protesting the death of an activist associated with the Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC), which was designated as a proscribed organisation two days prior.

According to security officials and human rights reports, the ensuing clashes resulted in at least 11 deaths — consisting of protesters and police officers — alongside dozens of injuries.

Over 70, including 23 security officials and 50 protesters, were injured, police chief Liaqat Malik said .

The state-run Pakistan TV reported on 9 June that videos showing an alleged assault on the Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) police personnel in Rawalakot on 7 June and the “desecration” of a deceased officer’s body had surfaced. It termed the incident a “preplanned attack”.

The same day, the AJK government ordered that “sedition charges be filed against [JAAC leader Shaukat Nawaz] Mir and another leader of the group, Mehran Arshad Khawaja, accusing them of inciting rebellion through speeches and online content”. It also announced a reward of PKR 10 million “for information leading to the arrest of four wanted members”.

According to a police statement, initial evidence indicated that “some of the five were in contact with ‘a hostile intelligence agency from a neighboring country’, without providing further details”.

The demonstrations originally took off against the 12 reserved seats in the legislature of Pakistan-administered Kashmir “for refugees from Indian-administered Kashmir who now live in other parts of Pakistan”. The JAAC has also demanded the abolition of these as they are not representative of actual residents of the region.

The AJK Supreme Court then ruled that those 12 reserved seats were constitutionally protected and an amendment was required to abolish them. Prior to that, the May 2026 talks between the JAAC and the government were unsuccessful .

The unrest escalated after the government deployed federal paramilitary forces ahead of a planned region-wide strike, said Amnesty International , which criticised the JAAC’s proscription in its statement as “disproportionate, unlawful, and a violation of the right to freedom of association”.

Amnesty also noted that authorities have targeted journalists reporting on the protests, with Sohrab Barkat arrested over alleged “defamation” and dissemination of “false and fake information”.

Alongside the arrest of over 100 members of the banned group, authorities suspended internet and mobile network signals and issued strict travel advisories restricting movement into the region until 27 July, when regional elections are scheduled. The JAAC’s head office was sealed by the AJK Police, according to the state-run Radio Pakistan .

Mir, the JAAC leader, termed the government actions “a massacre”, while Poonch sector commissioner Sardar Waheed Khan rejected the claim, terming it “misleading” and saying the state was trying to “restore law and order”.

Pakistan TV reported on 14 June that “armed individuals linked to the banned JAAC opened fire on an armoured vehicle during a police flag march in Rawalakot” and showed a video of armed men gathered at an unidentified location.

The state-run channel also reported on an alleged leaked recording between JAAC leader Sajid Azam, also the president of “Trade Union Thorar District Poonch”, and Hameed Kashmiri, a member of the banned group, discussing how they had “five hundred riflemen” ready and that they would demand to “vacate Rawalakot in two hours”.

Local officials reported mid-June that the main protest gatherings in Rawalakot had significantly dwindled , leading to a partial relaxation of curfew-like restrictions to allow for limited commercial hours.

On 18 June, AJK Prime Minister Faisal Mumtaz Rathore said Rawalakot was the “staging ground” of the JAAC’s “Campaign of Chaos” and that, from there, “they planned to march towards Muzaffarabad”.

“Even though the offer for negotiations still stands, we are not in [a] hurry (they should be) and the State will not capitulate. We’ll show flexibility to only those who want to de-escalate and want peace. We fully support the voices that demand fair rights, but we’ll never tolerate those who spread anarchy,” he added.

For the first step of this investigation, Soch Fact Check reverse-image searched both visuals to try to locate the source. However, the reverse-search did not yield any results.

Image 1 showing signs of manipulation highlighted in red

It is more difficult to verify news from the region at the moment, due to the internet blackout in Rawalakot. Soch Fact Check first reached out to an independent journalist Jalaluddin Mughal , who is currently based in Muzaffarabad, and specifically covers Azad Kashmir. He has covered the issues in Azad Kashmir in The New York Times and Urdu VOA . He verified the images and gave his analysis on the picture.

“This image does not appear to be a genuine photograph from Rawalakot for several reasons. First, the mountains visible in the background do not resemble the landscape typically seen around Rawalakot. Second, since a curfew has been imposed from 9 June 2026, and media access to the city has been restricted, it would be highly unlikely for such a photograph to have been taken on a street in Rawalakot during this period and posted on 13 June 2026.

Additionally, the street shown in the image does not look like a location within Rawalakot. I have also been unable to find any credible source verifying the image’s origin. Based on these observations, there are strong reasons to believe that the image is either manipulated or being circulated out of context to misrepresent the current situation in Rawalakot.”

His analysis shows a possibility of the picture being fake, as the reporter’s search, as well as Soch Fact Check’s , was inconclusive.

Image 2 showing signs of manipulation highlighted in red

Firstly, we investigated the sign of the shop named “AI Ashmit Imporium” at the top-left corner of the image. A search on Google Maps revealed there is no such store in Rawalakot, which further means that this image has been manipulated.

Soch Fact Check focused on the flag patch on the uniforms of the soldiers: one does not signify the Pakistani flag, and the flag patch on the arm of the soldier holding the box lacks depth and dimension.

Results from AI Detection Tools

According to Google DeepMind , SynthID embeds digital watermarks directly into AI-generated images, audio, text or video. The watermarks are embedded across Google’s generative AI consumer products, and are imperceptible to humans,  but can be detected by SynthID’s technology.

OpenAI added the “adding durable cross-platform SynthID watermarking to images through a partnership with Google”, the company announced in May 2026.

To validate the picture as AI-generated, Soch Fact Check ran the image through the OpenAI tool designed to check if it was created using the American company’s artificial intelligence tools.

The results confirmed that a SynthID watermark originating from OpenAI was found in the image, proving that an existing picture has been manipulated or has been modified using AI.

OpenAI identified the presence of a SynthID watermark in the image

OpenAI’s identified the presence of a SynthID watermark in the image

Therefore, Soch Fact Check concludes that artificial intelligence was used to manipulate an existing photo. Additionally, comments from the journalist, along with our own analysis, suggest that the area depicted in the images is not Rawalakot.

Virality

Upon investigation, Soch Fact Check , only found two posts on X with the most views at 55.7K views with 1.1k retweets.

The post circulated widely on Facebook, with 12 posts found in total. The main claim was posted in a group called ‘Shoaib Malik Giveaway’, which has 83K members.

Soch Fact Check has debunked other fake news surrounding the recent unrest in Rawalakot.

Conclusion: Soch Fact Check concluded that these images have been AI-manipulated.

title: Al Arabiya did not confirm that India supports the BLA
text:
Claim: A clip from an Al Arabiya broadcast confirms that India supports the Balochistan Liberation Army (BLA) against Pakistan.

Fact: The news clip does not support what is stated in the caption. The caption is misleading.

Facebook user Ali K Chisti posted the 24-second clip of the news broadcast. The video and caption did not include any translation or subtitles for what the anchor is saying, but the accompanying text stated :

“For the 1st time, Arab media confirms that India is supporting BLA terrorists against Pakistan. The Pakistan military killed 17 BLA militants in the last 2 days.”

Screenshot from Facebook reel

The whole news broadcast text on the screen is translated as :

[Red Breaking News (Bottom Corner) Kuwaiti Health Ministry: 7 urgent surgeries performed on those injured in the Iranian attack.]

Black Ticker (Bottom Corner) US Army: Iranian drones failed in an attempt to attack our forces in Kuwait.

Screenshot 2 : Security forces eliminate 17 Indian-backed militants in Balochistan” – Pakistan]

The presenter on screen is stated as saying :

[“The Pakistani army has announced the killing of 17 militants, describing them as being backed by India, during a series of security operations. The operations were based on intelligence information in the Balochistan province, located in the southwest of the country, and it was confirmed that weapons, ammunition, and explosive materials were seized during these operations]

On 24 May 2026, The Balochistan Liberation Army (BLA) , a separatist group, carried out a blast targeting a train carrying military personnel . Authorities said the train was on its way from Quetta to Pashewar when a vehicle with explosives hit the train, triggering the blast . This blast took place in the southwestern province of Balochistan and caused the death of 24 people, while more than 50 people were injured.

In order to investigate the clip, Soch Fact Check had to verify if the Pakistani Army published the news about killing 17 militants in a counter terrorism operation. Using a reverse-image search, we found news reports from 2 June 2026, and according to these reports the t Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) , the media wing of the Pakistan Army, was the one to give this information.

Hence, we can verify that the caption is misleading, as the news channel only reported  on what the government had commented, as seen below. The news slide is quoted as saying “Security forces eliminate 17 Indian-backed militants in Balochistan – Pakistan”. This matches what was said by  other outlets, and in the  ISPR’s broadcast, debunking the misleading caption posted by the Facebook user.

Screenshot from Facebook reel

On ISPR’s website we found the official statement on 2 June 2026 by the Pakistan Army, which was then broadcasted by Al Arabiya . Hence, the caption is a misrepresentation of what was actually said on the news channel.

Screenshot of ISPR’s statement

Comparing Facebook, and Instagram, we see more traction on Facebook as Ali K Chisti’s reel saw 920 likes and 88 reshares. Some Facebook reels saw a dip in interactions with 10 likes and 17 reshares. Meanwhile on Instagram, the post only has 2 likes.

On X, Soch Fact Check found more posts linked to this misleading claim, with a high view count of 23.6K views. Meanwhile, the least amount of views was 81 views, however on closer inspection we saw more interaction in the comments by Pakistani accounts.

Soch Fact Check has done an article based on this specific attack , as there has been a lot of misinformation around this incident.

Conclusion: The caption is misleading and does not match what is being said in  the news broadcast, and the news actually being shared was confirmed to Al Arabiya by the Pakistan Army.

title: No, Imran Khan is not set to be released
text:
Claim: Former Prime Minister Imran Khan is set to be released in upcoming weeks.

Fact: This claim is false. There are no official reports of Imran Khan being released.

On 31 May 2026, Facebook user UET Einsteins posted an image with a caption:

“More than 3 years behind bars — Imran Khan is set to walk free in the coming weeks as part of a possible deal, according to media reports,”

Disclaimer: This reflects a reported claim regarding a possible political and legal development. Details and outcomes may vary depending on official decisions and future events.”

The caption was posted alongside a photo below.

Screenshot from the Facebook Post

Soch Fact Check investigated Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf’s (PTI) official account on X to see if there had been an update on this matter.

As of 1 June 2026 we found that PTI had reposted an X post from Imran Khan’s lawyer , Khalid Yousaf Chaudry, who mentioned that he was not able to get signatures on the power of attorney for the Supreme Court appeal regarding the bail application in the Al-Qadir Trust case from former Prime Minister Imran Khan Sahib and his wife Bushra Khan. According to the lawyer’s X account as of 10 June 2026, the former Prime Minister might stay in jail as the jail administration had not obtained Khan’s or Bushra Bibi’s signatures on the power of attorney documents even until then.

Furthermore, Imran Khan’s sister Aleema Khan took to X on 1 June 2026 to say that such posts about a meeting in Adiala Jail between Khan and a former army chief were false.

Soch Fact Check also verified the claim by reaching out to media outlets like Geo News, as the viral source originated from media outlets. A representative from Geo News gave the following statement:

“There is no credibility in these reports, we have heard no such thing. This page itself is dubious.”

Soch Fact Check also reached out to  Aleema Khan who gave a comment on the matter stating :

“This is totally fake and a campaign launched by the agencies since they have no clue what to do.”

Considering the lack of credible news reports, and official statements from Khan’s sister Aleema Khan, Soch Fact Check debunks the claim as false.

The main post gained 1.1k likes and 34 shares on Facebook while on Instagram the interaction increased to 2.3K likes and 34 reshares.

Posts about the former Prime Minister’s release from jail sees fluctuations in the engagement on X as the highest views were 209.2K.

The claim that Imran Khan will be released, resurfaces from time to time since his arrest in August 2023. Soch Fact Check has debunked such fake or misleading news over this period of time.

Conclusion : The claim is false. There is no news regarding former PM Imran Khan’s released from Adiala Jail in the upcoming weeks.

title: China has not removed Israel from their map
text:
Claim: An image claims that China has removed the name “Israel” from its maps.

Fact: The official map of China shows Israel by its name. Moreover, commercial Chinese maps like Baidu and Amap do not display names of certain territories, including and not only Israel, at particular zoom levels but the territory remains visible when searching for the words “Israel”. The development is not new and likely predates Israel’s war in Gaza.

On 4 May 2026, Facebook user Asim Ahmed shared an image captioned:

“Breaking News

China has reportedly removed the name “Israel” from certain digital and printed maps, triggering international attention and diplomatic concern. The move has not been officially explained by Beijing, but analysts link it to rising geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Critics argue the step could escalate regional sensitivities, while supporters view it as a political signal. Israeli officials have not issued a formal response yet, but global observers are closely monitoring developments. The incident highlights how cartography can reflect political positions, not just geography. As reactions grow worldwide, this decision may further strain relations and deepen existing divides in international diplomacy”

This caption was attached with the following image:

Screenshot from Facebook post

In Mainland China, all Google services and maps are blocked due to the government’s stringent censorship laws . A Virtual Private Network (VPN) is required to access the maps that may likely be outdated and slow. Hence, maps lik e Baidu Maps and Amap , owne d by AliBaba Group, include the most accurate version of the Chinese map. Especially after 2010, Google refused to comply with China’s severe censorship laws , and this service was redirected to Hong Kong.

Soch Fact Check, cross checked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People’s Republic of China website , which led us to the following map seen below where Israel is pinned, while giving the right coordinates for further verified information. We found the map released by the Ministry of Natural Resources .

Chinese officials have repeatedly denied erasing Israel from the map specifically amidst the Hamas-Gaza conflict. Wang Wenbin , a ministry spokesperson, gave a statement about the normal diplomatic relations between the countries.

Map available on Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People’s Republic of China

Soch Fact Check at first verified the commercial maps Baidu and Amap to see if Israel had ever been removed. Neither map displays the label “Israel” on their platforms, although the country’s borders and cities remain visible. However, there are no reports to confirm this is a recent change, or that the label was removed after the 2023 Gaza conflict. No official confirmation has been given to the press by the government, as of 2026.

Furthermore, Soch Fact Check found a news report from 2023 about these commercial maps and the issues they face in terms of why countries explicitly might not be mentioned at a certain zoom level. Both Chinese applications, seen below, show Israel’s borders and name Israeli cities, but do not name the country. However,  the location data is very much up to date and available.

Soch Fact Check investigated Amap’s version for the word “Israel”, or in Traditional Chinese “以色列”. A search for the word ‘Israel’ brought up Israeli cities like Reim , Dimona , and Lift are visible on the map. The word Israel has not been removed from these applications search features.

Screenshot of Chinese and English map from AMAP

Soch Fact Check then investigated Baidu Maps . In 2023 Baidu made a statement on this issue saying that “Where space is limited, our maps may not display the names or flags of some territories.” Baidu presents similar results as Amap where cities in Israel are shown, and the geographic information stays present. Therefore, the investigation debunks the claim to be misleading, as we do not have enough information to state Israel has been removed from these maps.

Screenshot of Baidu Maps

Soch Fact Check found this news on various social media platforms, including Facebook, X and Instagram .

The most engagement of this post was seen on Instagram, however it is to note that many different variables of this claim have been circulated just with different pictures. Hence, some posts get 12 views on Instagram , whereas the same claim on X is engaging 500 plus views.

This news became quite popular due to Israel’s ongoing occupation of Gaza. China has been one of the superpowers that have spoken up against Israel condemning the military action in the Middle East, especially the West Bank. The news grew more popular, amongst users that were pro Gaza that made it grow more attraction.

Conclusion : Soch Fact Check concludes this claim as misleading, as official Chinese maps show the name Israel.

title: No, ARY News never said Imran Khan is being released
text:
Claim: Multiple social media posts show an ARY News bulletin stating that Former PM Imran Khan will be released in the upcoming week.

Fact: This claim is false. ARY News never reported any such news about Khan’s release.

On 13 May 2026, X user Salar Wazir PTI posted the bulletin where it stated:

بریکنگ نیوز “

عمران خان اسی ہفتے رہا ہو نگے انسانی ہمدردی کی بنیاد پر ہم ان کو رہا کر رہیں ہیں، رانا ثناء اللہ

رانا ثناء اللہ کی سابق اسپیکر قومی اسمبلی اسد قیصر سے ملاقات ، عمران خان کی رہائی کا پیغام پہنچایا  اسلام پہنچایا سے ملاقات ،

“[Transalation: Breaking News Imran Khan will be released this week, we are releasing him on humanitarian grounds, Rana Sanaullah .Rana Sanaullah meets former Speaker National Assembly Asad Qaiser, conveys message of Imran Khan’s release.]”

The visual shows Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on political affairs, Mr.Rana Sanuallah and Mr.Asad Qaiser, a member of the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) party.

Screenshot from X post

Soch Fact Check contacted ARY News to determine the veracity of this visual, as it was shared widely. A producer at the outlet confirmed that if such news had been broadcasted.. After looking into it, he stated:

“It looks fake. No such news has been run in my presence [and] even the font is not ours. It is fake.”

The fabricated visual was compared to an original ARY News bulletin to investigate the discrepancies  between the two, highlighted in red, with both screenshots posted below. The ARY News logo is very similar to the one in the manipulated image, however there is an uneven spacing and alignment between the words, as seen in the word “NEWS.” This suggests that a different font was used for every word. Meanwhile, the original logo is consistent in all these aspects, and is much brighter than the one seen in the viral posts..

Soch Fact Check , discovered a similar instance with the yellow color used for the “ بریکنگ نیوز” [Breaking News] in the news bulletin board. In comparison, it seems to be slightly darker than the outlet’s normal broadcast, even though the font is the same as the original.

The fade strip between the live footage and the red bulletin panel is visible in the original screenshot featuring US President Donald Trump, where the fade is consistent, smooth and naturally fades into the live broadcast running.However, there is no TV transition layer, or even a semi-transparent gradient in Rana Sanullah’s breaking news bulletin. Genuine live broadcasting templates are continuously in transition, and not in a still boundary or static.

Furthermore, the blue box at the bottom of the screenshots is also not integrated into the broadcast of Rana Sanaullah, and the Urdu font is more delicate. Upon investigation, it seems like an altered ticker was used here.

In conclusion, when the news bulletins are compared based on these details, and given the official statement confirming that no such statement was ever made, we can conclude that the news bulletin was altered.

News clipping from X

News clipping from official ARY News Youtube Channel

Soch Fact Check found this news on various social media platforms, including14 Facebook posts, 5  X posts,  5 Thread posts, 1 Youtube video and 5 Instagram posts.

This ARY News bulletin in particular had become quite popular due to the resharing by PTI supporters, not only nationally, but also internationally. Facebook groups containing more than 200K people in particular tend to spread such misinformation rapidly.

Conclusion: ARY News did not report that Imran Khan will be released, and the image being shared has been manipulated. An ARY producer also confirmed the same.

title: Video showing close-up of Trump rescued at White House Correspondent’s Dinner is A-generated.
text:
Claim : A viral video shows US President Donald Trump being evacuated by his security detail from the White House Correspondents’ Dinner.

Fact: The video is likely AI-generated.

On 28 April 2026, F acebook user Naimat Khuhro posted a video with the following caption in Sindhi:

ايران تي پَنجاھ پَنجاھ مڻن جا ھزارين بم ھڻندڙ آمريڪي صدر ٽرمپوءَ جو ھِڪ ھوائي فائر تي ساھ پيو نڪري، ۽ ڊرامو اِيئن پيو ڪري، ڄڻ ته پيٽ ۾ گولي لڳي اَٿس/ حملو ناڪام ٿيڻ تي شھباز شريف کي خُوشي ٿِي، ۽ اسانکي ڏاڍي تڪليف پُھتي آھي/ ڪاش! حملو ڪندڙ ماستر پَنھنجي مقصد ۾ ڪامياب ٿئي ھا تہ جيڪر ڪروڙين اربين انسانن جي ھِن وحشي قاتل ۽ دَجال مان جان آجي ٿِي پَوي ھا!

“ [Translation: US President Trump, who dropped 50,000 bombs on Iran, is dying of a single air strike, and the drama is going on as if he was shot in the stomach/ Shahbaz Sharif is happy that the attack failed, and we are in great pain/ I wish! The master attacker had succeeded in his goal, if only the lives of millions of people had been saved by this brutal murderer and antichrist!”

The video shows US President Donald Trump looking shocked as he is escorted out by his security detail after a second assassination attempt.

On 26 April 2026, a shooting incident occurred during the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner at the Washington Hilton hotel. The suspect, later identified as Cole Tomas Allen, was armed with a shotgun, handgun, and knives. Secret Service Spokesman Anthony Guglielmi said that Allen opened fire near the main screening area at the entrance of the event. He was then tackled and arrested.

US Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche told NBC News that the suspect was likely targeting US President Donald Trump and officials in his administration.

Footage by CNN shows the attendees taking cover behind their tables as the security personnel rushed to cover Trump and first lady, Melania Trump, who bent down behind the dais before being escorted out by the officers. Security agents also provided cover for other cabinet officials including Vice President JD Vance, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., and Interior Secretary Doug Burgum.

After an hour of the incident, Trump announced on his Truth Social account that the “shooter has been apprehended”.

Allen is a 31 year-old teacher and engineer from Torrance, California. NBC News claims that a senior official from the US administration has provided them with a transcript of Allen’s writings which show that the suspect had sent a message to his parents, colleagues, and students, before the attack. He had apologised for what he was about to do as he believed that it was his “duty” to target Trump administration officials.

Soch Fact Check reverse-imaged the thumbnail of the videos and photos to see if it matches the official videos that were released by news reports on the date of the incident.

When analysed alongside with the claim, we found there are no close-up videos of security escorting President Donald Trump away from the stage. Two official clips were released, one is a video of the US President and First Lady Melania Trump engaged in conversation with mentalist Oz Pearlman , as shots are heard being fired.

The next clip shows Donald Trump being escorted out with security gathered around him, as US Police stomped the stage .

The only close-up shot taken on 25 April 2026 shows Vice President JD Vance , being taken away from the stage by his security detail. These are three main clips circulating social media.

Soch Fact Check verified the video by running it through Deepware AI Scanner , which assesses videos with different AI-based scanners that check for synthetic manipulation and produce a probability score.

Running it through the Avartify scanner yielded the highest probability, indicating the video is 90% likely a deepfake. Avartify is an AI-powered deepfake detection tool, specifically focused on using facial animation to analyse videos for altered facial animation within a video, or even called as a puppetry tool. This can be seen in the beginning of the video, where Trump’s expression seems to be motionless and stationery with the shocked expression not moving at all..

Furthermore, the Seferbekov scanner has been designed to detect inconsistencies between the person’s head movement and the surrounding background pixels. This scanner saw 56% of suspicious activity, which also suggested AI alteration.

However, results from the other two scanners Deepware at 29% and Ensemble at 43% of a deepfake not being detected. Therefore, results from Deepware Scanner were inconclusive.

The results are pictured below:

Results from Deepware Scanner

Soch Fact Check then ran the video through DeepFake-O-Meter for further verification. DeepFake-O-Meter gave us the report below. Even though the summarized result is Mixed Signals, all scanners giving a high to moderate score can be seen as an indicator that the video was in fact a deepfake.

The report shows five scanners that show a high score of deepfake, this included AVSRDD, DSP-FWA, Altfreezing, XCLIP, and LSDA. All detected different things in AI-generated videos for example. The percentage and their functions have been stated below for clarity:

Result from DeepFake-O-Meter

Also seen below are four scanners that gave moderate scores, which add to the suspicious nature of the video. These four scanners are stated below:

Results from DeepFake-O-Meter

When reviewing the forensic analysis done by AI-detection tools, and official coverage of the incident from credible international news outlets from the day of the Correspondent’s dinner, it can be established that the video is not authentic, and likely AI-generated.

Virality

Soch Fact Check found the claim circulating here , here , here , here , here , here , here , here , and here on Facebook.

On Instagram, it was shared here and here .

On Youtube, it was found here.

On Tiktok, it was found here .

Conclusion: The claim is false as the video is likely AI-generated. __________________________________________________________________________________________
